activation_gate: Keep every rule paused until the contact point, exact routes, renderer cases, one controlled firing, and its resolved notification have all been verified.

rules.title: Bonaparte dashboard unavailable
rules.summary: At least two of three Bonaparte health probes are failing.
rules.description: The production dashboard is unavailable or its configuration and last-good timeline cache are not ready.

rules.title: Bonaparte pipeline freshness delayed
rules.summary: At least two of three Bonaparte freshness probes are failing.
rules.description: The freshness receipt is delayed, cannot refresh, or is being served from the stale cache.

rules.title: Bonaparte synthetic telemetry missing
rules.summary: A complete Bonaparte synthetic check has emitted no metrics for ten minutes.
rules.description: Production availability or freshness cannot be evaluated because a synthetic job or its datasource is missing.

rules.title: Bonaparte Supabase telemetry missing
rules.summary: Bonaparte Postgres, pooler, or waiting-client metrics have been absent for five minutes.
rules.description: Database headroom cannot be evaluated because the scoped Supabase metrics integration is disconnected or stale.

rules.title: Bonaparte Supabase connection pool queue sustained
rules.summary: More than five database clients have waited for a pooled connection continuously for ten minutes.
rules.description: Sustained connection pressure may delay dashboard refreshes and durable queue processing.
